tickets.title: Evaluate potential lapse and reinstatement
tickets.text: Evaluate the potential lapse and possible reinstatement of Soren Cloudpuddle’s $750,000 Paper Otter Life 20‑year term policy after the draft failure when his Teacup Comet Bank checking account was replaced, ensuring the existing underwriting terms are preserved.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term life and disability needs
tickets.text: Review Soren Cloudpuddle’s term life coverage and disability protection needs now that Lila Cloudpuddle has reduced her paid work to part‑time, increasing household reliance on his salary and exposing the $620,000 mortgage, childcare and education‑funding obligations.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
